item.title: Horoscope for Sunday, September 27, 2026
item.dc:creator: Georgia Nicols
item.description:
Moon Alert

Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions from 10 a.m. to noon. The moon moves from Taurus into Gemini.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

★★★A so-so day

Errands pile up before lunch. Knock out the dull ones first and the afternoon opens up.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

★★★★A positive day

Money matters look friendlier than they did last week, so this is a good day to sort out a bill or ask a direct question about pay. A neighbour or sibling has news worth hearing. Keep the evening simple — a quiet meal at home suits you better than a crowd.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

★★★★★A dynamic day

The moon enters your sign today, and you feel it by midday.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

★★★A average day

Tidy one corner of your space; it clears your head more than you expect.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

★★★A average day

Someone close to you wants a straight answer, and today you can give one without it turning into a debate. Travel plans or a class you’ve been eyeing come back into focus. Don’t sign anything big before noon; after that, you’re on firmer ground.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

★★★★A positive day

Shared resources and practical favours are the theme today.
